newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks end modestly higher.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks end modestly higher.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks ended with only modest gains on Friday, after making a run at their year high in afternoon trade, with investors cautious ahead of next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting.
The Hang Seng index closed 5.68 points higher at 11,592.36 after reaching a session high of 11,642.54. This was just shy of its year high of 11,645.35 points hit on Tuesday.
"There is a bit of caution ahead of next Tuesday's FOMC (Federal Open Market Committee) meeting," said Andrew Fernow, director of research at Vickers Ballas.
He said there was a strong possibility that the U.S. Federal Reserve could raise the discount rate by 25 basis points.
With the possibility of a rate increase hanging over the market, analysts said investors had turned to market laggards and defensive plays this session.
"There is some rotation. Some of the laggards are moving up," said Frederick Tsang, head of research at PrimeEast Securities (HK) Ltd, pointing to the utlities sector.
China Light shares rose HK$0.40 to HK$35.80 and Hongkong Electric added HK$0.15 to HK$24.00.
"When the market reaches these levels, a lot of people seek defensive stocks," Tsang added.
Market turnover this session rose to HK$5.15 billion compared to HK$4.81 billion on Thursday.
HSBC Holdings was well sought after, rising HK$1.00 to HK$141.50 after hitting a new all-time high at HK$142.50.
"HSBC reflects the U.K. market rather than the Hong Kong market. The U.K market is quite hot," said Tsang.
Other banking stocks did not fare so well, with Hang Seng Bank ending the session down HK$0.25 at HK$79.25 and Bank of East Asia unchanged at HK$28.50.
"Some stocks are still under consolidation," said Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities. "I think there is still a bit of selling around 11,600 points," he said.
Hysan Development Co reported interim net profit of HK$697.45 million compared with HK$632.28 million. The stock ended the session down HK$0.55 at HK$23.65.
Henderson Land rose HK$0.50 at HK$64.50 and Sun Hung Kai Properties advanced HK$0.50 to HK$79.00.
September Hang Seng futures fell 25 points to 11,570.
Over the week, the Hang Seng index gained 223.32 points, or 1.96 percent.
